nav.description: Top-level items. Each: label, url; optional layout ("columns" shows every tab at once, one column per tab topped by its heading, instead of the tab rail; the item's label is drawn as an eyebrow only when no tab has a heading; featured lists and cards are not drawn then); optional tabs, each with key, label, url (renders the tab as a link), heading, groups [{ heading, links [{ title, desc, url, icon }] }] an optional featured list [{ type, title, desc, url, cta }] (resource cards beside the links; desktop only) and an optional card { image, image_alt, logo, logo_alt, title, quote, author, role, url } (used when a tab has no featured list). Items without tabs render as plain links. Icons and images are files in assets/ or URLs.
